skim.know_text: Again, assuming Bernal from generality of device results

final.reanalysis: I'm unsure about the validity of the analysis here as well as interpretation of data. I generally found the FFT vs temperature analysis to be the most convincing
final.overall_read: Handling of the measurement was good (aside from the heavy noise), but it seems to be cooking up unusual tests to determine stacking, or atleast unusual to me.
final.biggest_wrong: More could have been made in analysis of the activated behaviour. For example plots of the gap
